title: Understanding Artificial Intelligence
introduction: Artificial intelligence is a way of making computer systems perform tasks that normally require aspects of human intelligence.
learningOutcomes: Describe artificial intelligence in simple terms.
Distinguish an AI system from conventional rule-based software.

activities.question: Which description best fits an AI system?
options: A system that finds patterns to make predictions or decisions
Any program stored on a computer
A machine that always thinks exactly like a person
A program that never makes mistakes
activities.explanation: AI systems commonly use patterns in data to produce predictions, decisions or generated content.

activities.question: All software is artificial intelligence.
activities.explanation: Much conventional software follows explicitly written rules without learning patterns from data.
